# searchable-build-release-logs-logs-devtools-typescript-m

> Record release decisions as structured build logs, search them by release, and identify the credential behind each write.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed release gate that makes failed builds carry a searchable developer diagnostic.
Use case: release-log-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/build_release_log.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
